selection: Registered nodes whose primary interface is a checkpoint, diffusion-model, text-encoder, VAE, or LoRA loader; a loader tuple or pipe; or a LoRA stack builder or applier. Prompt and conditioning nodes that apply LoRAs incidentally are excluded with media, detector, adapter, upscaler, SAM, file, and text loaders.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP, LoRA and block selection -> MODEL, CLIP
records.reason: Selective DiT block patches cannot be represented by canonical whole-model LoRA application.

records.signature: checkpoint and config options -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE
records.reason: The ordinary checkpoint tuple maps to dinkster.load_checkpoint.

records.signature: diffusion model and dtype options -> MODEL
records.reason: The standalone diffusion model maps to dinkster.load_diffusion_model.

records.signature: VAE name -> VAE
records.reason: Dinkster has no native standalone VAE carrier, and forcing a checkpoint runtime would change execution identity.

records.signature: GGUF model and options -> MODEL
records.reason: The GGUF backend and quantization options are not represented by the canonical diffusion asset loader.

records.signature: MODEL, LoRA and advanced strengths/options -> MODEL
records.reason: Architecture-specific patch options are not canonical whole-model LoRA semantics.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP and four LoRA slots -> MODEL, CLIP
records.reason: The ordered fixed slots map directly to the native model-and-CLIP LoRA stack.

records.signature: optional MODEL, optional CLIP and dynamic LoRA records -> MODEL, CLIP
records.reason: The arbitrary dynamic record dictionary cannot be decoded into native input-family members by ReplacementRule.

records.signature: checkpoint, VAE, LoRAs, prompts and latent settings -> loader pipe and components
records.reason: The loader portion maps to the checkpoint stack; prompt and latent behavior lowers separately.

records.signature: checkpoint, VAE, LoRAs, prompts and settings -> loader pipe, MODEL, VAE
records.reason: The loader portion maps to the checkpoint stack; A1111 prompt encoding lowers separately.

records.signature: checkpoint, VAE, LoRAs, prompts and settings -> loader pipe, MODEL, VAE
records.reason: The loader portion maps to the checkpoint stack; prompt encoding lowers separately.

records.signature: SVD checkpoint, VAE, image and video settings -> loader pipe, MODEL, VAE
records.reason: Video conditioning and pipe state are outside loader-stack dataflow.

records.signature: SV3D checkpoint, VAE, image and camera schedule -> loader pipe, MODEL, STRING
records.reason: Image and camera conditioning cannot be preserved by a loader shortcut.

records.signature: Zero123 checkpoint, VAE, image and camera values -> loader pipe, MODEL, VAE
records.reason: Image-conditioned camera dataflow is not a loader stack.

records.signature: Cascade stages B/C, stage A VAE, CLIP, LoRAs and prompts -> loader pipe and stage components
records.reason: Native Stable Cascade execution is unavailable; do not expose a nonfunctional shortcut.

records.signature: UNet, VAE, ChatGLM3, LoRAs, prompts and settings -> loader pipe and components
records.reason: The architecture-specific non-CLIP encoder and pipe contract have no canonical stack equivalent.

records.signature: checkpoint, VAE, LoRAs, prompts and settings -> loader pipe, MODEL, VAE
records.reason: The ordinary loader portion maps to the checkpoint stack; prompt and latent behavior lowers separately.

records.signature: checkpoint, VAE, LoRAs, prompts and settings -> loader pipe, MODEL, VAE
records.reason: The ordinary loader portion maps to the checkpoint stack; prompt and latent behavior lowers separately.

records.signature: DiT checkpoint, VAE, CLIP, T5, LoRAs, prompts and settings -> loader pipe and components
records.reason: The custom multi-encoder recipe and pipe contract have no canonical stack equivalent.

records.signature: checkpoint, VAE, prompts and video latent settings -> loader pipe, MODEL, VAE
records.reason: Video conditioning and latent construction are outside loader-stack dataflow.

records.signature: selector, strength, up to 50 LoRAs and optional stack -> LORA_STACK, selected name
records.reason: The opaque LORA_STACK result and selected-name output cannot be converted to native family members without losing connected dataflow.

records.signature: mode, up to 10 LoRAs and strengths, optional prior stack -> LORA_STACK
records.reason: ReplacementRule cannot turn the opaque LORA_STACK output or prior stack input into native family members.

records.signature: LORA_STACK, MODEL and optional CLIP -> MODEL, CLIP
records.reason: ReplacementRule cannot decode the opaque LORA_STACK input into native family members.

records.signature: config and checkpoint names -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE, name
records.reason: Its explicit config-file selection cannot be preserved by Dinkster's native guess-config checkpoint loader.

records.signature: checkpoint name -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE, name
records.reason: The checkpoint tuple maps to dinkster.load_checkpoint; compatibility lowering must preserve a connected name output.

records.signature: local Diffusers repository path -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE, name
records.reason: A mutable local repository path cannot become a content-addressed checkpoint asset without a sourcing contract.

records.signature: repository id and revision -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE, name
records.reason: Network acquisition and mutable revision selection are outside execution-time loader nodes.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP, LoRA and strengths -> MODEL, CLIP, name
records.reason: The LoRA application maps to dinkster.load_lora; compatibility lowering must preserve a connected name output.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP, LoRA and strengths -> MODEL, CLIP, name
records.reason: This second registered alias has the same canonical LoRA lowering and connected-name requirement as Load Lora.

records.signature: checkpoint name -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE, CLIP_VISION, name
records.reason: The additional CLIP vision resident is not produced by the canonical checkpoint stack.

records.signature: LoRA names and model-strength sweep strings -> LORA_PARAMS
records.reason: Strength ranges describe a sampling sweep rather than sequential application, and the current consumer intentionally uses only the first LoRA.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP, LoRA, strengths and hidden prompt -> MODEL, CLIP, example text
records.reason: LoRA application delegates to the core loader; compatibility lowering must preserve connected example text.

records.signature: checkpoint and hidden prompt -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE, example text
records.reason: Checkpoint loading delegates to the core loader; compatibility lowering must preserve connected example text.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP, LoRA, strengths and block vector -> MODEL, CLIP, populated vector
records.reason: Per-block patch weighting is not canonical whole-model LoRA semantics.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP, LoRA and block vector -> LBW_MODEL, STRING
records.reason: The intermediate block-weight patch object has no canonical LoRA representation.

records.signature: MODEL, CLIP, strengths and LBW_MODEL -> MODEL, CLIP
records.reason: Applying a precomputed block-weight object is not canonical whole-model LoRA semantics.

records.signature: block-weight file -> LBW_MODEL
records.reason: The pack-specific block-weight object has no canonical LoRA representation.

records.signature: checkpoint, key and cache mode -> MODEL, CLIP, VAE, cache key
records.reason: Mutable shared-cache identity is not part of the content-addressed loader contract.

records.signature: diffusion model, dtype, key and cache mode -> MODEL, cache key
records.reason: Mutable shared-cache identity is not part of the content-addressed loader contract.

records.signature: one to three encoders, type, device, key and cache mode -> CLIP, cache key
records.reason: Mutable cache keys and a variable multi-encoder recipe have no canonical stack equivalent.

records.signature: Cascade stages B/C, keys and cache mode -> stage models, VAEs, CLIP vision, CLIP and keys
records.reason: Native Stable Cascade execution is unavailable; cache keys and CLIP vision also lack native equivalents.

records.signature: checkpoint, cache key, prompts, CLIP skip, seed and optional VAE -> BASIC_PIPE, cache key
records.reason: The only functional output is a cache-coupled pipe containing two wildcard/LoRA prompt passes and conditioning, so loader-only replacement cannot preserve it.

records.signature: checkpoint, VAE, LoRAs, prompts, latent settings and optional stacks -> components and dependencies
records.reason: The loader portion maps to the checkpoint stack; prompt, latent, ControlNet and script behavior lowers separately.

records.signature: base and refiner checkpoints, VAE, prompts, settings and optional stacks -> SDXL tuple and dependencies
records.reason: The connected SDXL tuple owns two checkpoint runtime identities that one native provider invocation cannot preserve.

records.signature: mode, up to 50 LoRAs and strengths, optional prior stack -> LORA_STACK
records.reason: ReplacementRule cannot turn the opaque LORA_STACK output or prior stack input into native family members.

records.signature: upscale mode, optional checkpoint and high-resolution settings -> SCRIPT
records.reason: Conditional loading is embedded in a sampler script rather than a loader dataflow.
